description: Pruning of a Robinia tree (T3) in the front garden, subject to Tree Preservation Order TPO/433/03/23; by reducing height by no more than 2.5 metres, lateral spread by no more than 1.5 metres and removal of all deadwood throughout.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - In accordance with British Standard BS3998:2010, the pruning of the Robinia tree (T3) subject to Tree Preservation Order TPO/433/03/23 shall only be carried out in the following manner:

-  reducing height by no more than 2.5 metres, lateral spread by no more than 1.5 metres and removal of all deadwood throughout.

To preserve the health of the Robinia tree (T3) subject to Tree Preservation Order TPO/433/03/23  as well as the visual amenity of the surrounding area in accordance with policies OS5 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 2 - No less than five working days' notice shall be given to the Council's Aboricultural Officer before any work commences to the tree (Telephone 07980617394). 

In order that the Council has the opportunity to ensure that the work is carried out in accordance with Condition 1, in accordance with Policy OS5 of the Local Plan (2018).
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
